text_block_list.text: One afternoon――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've called me… Are you finally going to 
confess!? The perpetrator of the other 
day's bombing incident was none other than 
you, Ms. Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Calm down. Today, I have a favor to ask of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Class president! Honor student! Only you! 
I have a request that only you can 
fulfill!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh! Is that so～! Heehee～! If that's 
the case, then by all means, please do 
rely on me for any and all of your needs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! Thank you for your honesty. Now, 
take a look at that clock.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It emits a special kind of radio wave, not 
unlike standard radio waves, that turns 
the brain into a kind of receiver. It acts 
on the pineal gland, causing it to produce 
melatonin――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmhm!? Pineal… Receive… Mela…!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words! You're going to have some 
serious sleep issues, but I want to see 
you use them to grow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Grow! I see, that's where the honor roll 
student comes in! All right! I'm going to 
face off against sleepiness, and―

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Guuuh～～～～…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hypnotic induction was successful. Next 
phase. ―You're gracefully running along a 
sandy beach at dusk, are you not?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Indeed! My legs are so light! It's as 
if I could fly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then take flight through the air and, 
――cross over the limits of… the event 
horizon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Over… the limits～～!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hooohhhh～～!? At last, I'm Bakushin-ing 
the sky～～!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmgnnghhm? …Huh, what in the world am I 
doing? Where's the beach at dusk??

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good, good, good! Now, let's demonstrate. 
…Ms. President, I'm the one who blew up 
your classroom the other day!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I beg your pardon!? Not once, but twice! 
To blow up a sacred classroom and, 
and～～!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've got you now, Ms. Tachyon! With a very 
graceful run, at that!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all… it seems your running style has 
clearly changed. In other words, this 
escapade proved it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
――That my theory of hypnotic running 
improvement theory was correct!

From that day on, Sakura Bakushin O's 
running was refined!
